mechanism_of_action: Novel, orally bioavailable small molecule with anti-inflammatory activity.
primary_endpoint: Mean change from baseline in cholesterol efflux capacity at 12 weeks and triglyceride levels at 8 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Open-label arm: cholesterol efflux capacity changed by −0.013 at 12 weeks; triglycerides changed by −21.67 mg/dL at 8 weeks. No comparator or statistical significance was reported.
safety_signal: No serious adverse events among 19 participants; no deaths.
